_comment: Synthetic memories for retrieval tests. Every record here is INVENTED.
No real user memory is in this file, and none will be: a memory store is personal
content, and 'anonymised' personal content does not belong in a public repository.
Written by hand instead, which turns out to be better evidence rather than a
compromise -- the adversarial cases below are CONSTRUCTED to share a word with a
record they must not recall, whereas in a real store such pairs only exist by luck.
The point of the corpus is issue #2: a query sharing one two-character word with a
record used to recall it. FRAGMENT was 0.6 and the floor's lower bound is also 0.6,
so a single shared 2-gram reached the floor unaided.
Shape matches lib/store.js records: importance 1, accessCount 0, and createdAt ==
updatedAt == BASE_TIME so scoreRecord returns `base` with all three multipliers at 1.

records.content: 用户偏好：使用中文回复，技术术语可保留英文（不强制翻译）。
records._why: The target of the classic false positive. Tagged 语言, and 回复 appears in the content -- the combination that made every naive corroboration rule fail one way or the other.

records.content: 反代超时默认 60 秒会导致 504。
records._why: A paraphrase target: the query 反向代理超时 shares no whole word with 反代超时, so it must be found through fragments. Kept SHORT on purpose -- bigram Jaccard is a ratio, so padding a record with a second clause dilutes it below the floor. The first draft of this record was 33 characters and scored 0 where the 16-character version scores 0.7095. That is pre-existing behaviour (a long record is harder for a short query to reach), not something this release changed, but it makes an unrealistically verbose fixture test the dilution rather than the fix.

records.content: 解决办法二选一：接口异步化，或调大反代超时。
records._why: A second genuine hit for the same query, so ranking has something to order.

records.content: 灯泡光电报告的处理流程走 LM-79 标准，看 CRI 和 R9 两个值。
records._why: The hardest false positive. It shares 处理/理流/流程 with 这个技能的处理流程是怎样的 and used to score 1.7541 -- ABOVE a real hit's 0.8393 -- so no floor could separate them. It is still recalled; what must hold now is that it ranks below a genuine match.

records.content: 技能的处理流程是：先结晶成 skill，再按新经验精炼，闲置久了归档。
records._why: The record 这个技能的处理流程是怎样的 SHOULD find, so that query is not purely adversarial: it must outrank the lamp report.

records.content: 备份定时任务每天凌晨 3 点跑，失败会写 systemd journal 但不发通知。
records._why: Filler with its own vocabulary: it must never surface for any query below.

records.content: 部署顺序：先迁移数据库，再切流量，回滚时反过来。
records._why: Filler, and shares 回 with 回复语言 at the single-character level -- unigram Jaccard must not be enough on its own.

records.content: The staging environment uses a self-signed certificate, so curl needs -k there.
records._why: An English record: ASCII word matching must keep working, and it must not be recalled by Chinese queries.

queries._why: Per-word tag matching exists for this. The old test asked whether the WHOLE query was a substring of one tag, so this scored 0 against tags ['语言','中文','回复风格'].
Same record, chatty phrasing. Stopword-laden fragments (要求/什么) must not drown it.
The query IS the tag, with nothing left to corroborate. It must still be findable, or tags stop being searchable by name.
Paraphrase recall: no whole word is shared with 反代超时.
Issue #2 itself. Shares the word 语言 with syn_lang_pref's tag, and 编程 appears nowhere in it. Must return NOTHING.
The same defect via a different word, so a fix cannot be special-cased to 编程.
Entirely unrelated. Anything returned here is pure noise.
